raw_definitions: Definisi : throwing off her nervousness, she sallied forth to face the audience , melupakan rasa gentarnya, dia mara utk menghadapi para penonton. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : ~ / forth, out /, (old-fashioned) mara: the gates of the fort opened and the troops sallied out , pintu masuk kubu itu terbuka dan askar-askar pun mara; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : 2. witty remark , kata-kata yg lucu: the audience roared with laughter at his sallies , penonton ketawa berdekah-dekah mendengar kata-katanya yg lucu; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : n 1. sortie , serangan cepat: these sallies usually take place at dawn , serangan-serangan cepat itu biasanya berlaku pd waktu subuh; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
